title: Huge glowing craft over the November 5 missile site
place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: The diameter of that thing was so big that it actually exceeded the perimeters of the fence line.

As we did, we immediately saw the object hovering directly over the site. It made no noise and was a huge glowing, reddish-orange sphere. It was only 15-20 feet above the ground and it was roughly the width of a Wal-Mart building!
Its surface was shimmering with the red and orange colors constantly swirling and churning.

plain: In 1977 a huge glowing object is said to have hovered over November 5, one of the launch sites for nuclear missiles around Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. A former Air Force missile security guard named Mario Woods, who says he was there, tells Michels the thing was so wide that "it actually exceeded the perimeters of the fence line." The journalist Robert Hastings, who writes about UFOs seen at nuclear weapons sites, published Woods's account on 10 September 2017. In that article Woods says that he and his partner "immediately saw the object hovering directly over the site." He describes "a huge glowing, reddish-orange sphere" that made no noise, only 15 to 20 feet off the ground and "roughly the width of a Wal-Mart building." Its surface, he says there, was "shimmering with the red and orange colors constantly swirling and churning." So the story reaches the reader twice from the same witness: once in his own voice on the show, and once in a journalist's written account years earlier. If it is true, something enormous and silent sat right on top of an American nuclear missile.
